description: Applies the major runic blessing of the Pit Fighter. When you are
critically hit with this blessing active you temporarily gain a 3% bonus
to Armor, Protection, PvP Armor, and PvP Protection. Only one major
runic blessing can be active at any time.

items.name: Major Rune Stone of the Second Wind

description: Applies the major runic blessing of the Second Wind. This blessing
increases the effect of both stamina and mana potions, in addition to
providing a 5% increase to Armor and Protection while stamina and
mana potions are active. Only one major runic blessing can be active at
Applies the runic blessing of Shared Bloodshed. This blessing provides
you with a passive bonus to Fatality Chance and Spell Fatality Chance.
This bonus doubles when your health is less than 25%. Only one runic
blessing can be active at any time.

items.name: Rune Stone of the Last Resort

description: Applies the runic blessing of the Last Resort. When your health is 20% or
lower with this blessing active, you will be provided with a 5% increase
to Base Spell Damage and a 10% increase to Weapon Damage (Melee).
Only one runic blessing can be active at any time.
